rules.statement: On the death of a donee without issue, their interest under a deed of gift does not accrue to the surviving donees or their progeny if the deed limits the fidei commissum to the donees and does not indicate an intention to preserve the property for coming persons.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am therefore of opinion that the principles laid down in the case of Perera v. Silva (supra) and Carron v. Manuel (supra) are entirely applicable to the deed of gift, which is the subject of this appeal, and venture to hold the learned District Judge was wrong in applying to it the rule laid down in the case of Carlinahamy v. Juanis (supra)."
